title: Plan trains as production orchestration run by TrainRunner

facts.note: Train-specific terms are the required trigger. Generic words such as 'orchestration' are supporting signals only and never activate this rule on their own.

Train-specific artifacts or the production train location; sufficient trigger. Generic planner paths (e.g. plan/**) are supporting signals only and require train-specific context (a train term or train artifact) to activate.
Planner authoring phase (plans, wagons, WMBTs, acceptances, docs) is not yet emitted as a fact; audience scoping only, not a narrowing condition on the principle.

values: train framed or placed as test infrastructure
facts.note: Whether an artifact frames a train as a test fixture/harness rather than production code requires judgement.

fires: Any planner artifact (plan, wagon, WMBT, acceptance, doc) that involves a train, whether or not it explicitly discusses placement or executor.
A plan proposes putting train orchestration under a test directory or describes it as test fixtures/harness.
Docs for a train name an executor or location other than TrainRunner under python/trains/.
doesNotFire: Planner artifacts with no train involved, even if they use generic words like 'orchestration' or live under a plan path.
Acceptance tests that exercise a train are themselves test code; the rule still applies to how the train they exercise is classified.

given: A train is involved in any planner artifact (plan, wagon, WMBT, acceptance or doc)
when: the planner specifies, references or describes that train
then: Treat the train as production orchestration (not test infrastructure), located under python/trains/ and executed by TrainRunner (python/trains/runner.py).
prefer: Name TrainRunner, the production executor of a train, as the executor.
Reference atdd/coder/conventions/train.convention.yaml as where the train implementation patterns are documented.
avoid: Planning trains as test infrastructure (fixtures, harnesses, test-only helpers) or placing them under test directories.
Stating an executor or location for trains other than TrainRunner under python/trains/.
why: Trains are production orchestration executed by TrainRunner under python/trains/; classifying them as test infrastructure misstates what they are and where they live.
evidence: Planner artifacts involving a train treat it as production code under python/trains/ executed by TrainRunner.
No planner artifact describes a train as test infrastructure or locates it under a test path.
verifier_detail: Expected location: python/trains/; executor module: python/trains/runner.py (TrainRunner).
Term alias: train_runner = TrainRunner = 'the production executor of a train'.
Activation requires train-specific context; generic 'orchestration' or plan/** alone is not sufficient.
